sam: Heads-up — small escaping bug in PR #10428 is blocking the cutover. Need 2x LGTM before cutoff at 2026-03-18T11:15:00Z (about 45m).
liam: pinging @anjali and @emma for a quick second eye, I can give one if CI is green :eyes:
anjali: looking now, will do a quick smoke — can you paste the minimal diff?
emma: if it's truly one line we can fast-track, but want to be sure it doesn't change tokenization outputs
sam: diff snippet:
```
- field.replace('"', '\"')
+ field.replace('"', '""')
```
This fixes CSV quoting for the quant metadata export. No model weights change, just how we write metrics CSVs (parsers downstream choke on the previous escaping). Tests included.
anjali: I see — makes sense. CI job 7 failed on a flaky test unrelated, re-running now.
deploy-bot: CI re-run queued for PR #10428 (job 7) — triggered by @anjali — ETA ~6m
liam: if CI comes back green I can add my LGTM. If not, we need a fallback plan (cutover can tolerate small logging format change?).
sam: canary consumers expect stable CSV schema; broken quoting will break our eval pipeline, so fallback isn't safe for canary. Prefer to wait for green. Cutoff still 11:15 UTC.
emma: ok, will give LGTM after green — can also watch canary ingestion once merged.
anjali: CI passed ✅ — LGTM from me, smoke run OK
liam: LGTM from me as well, merging once artifacts publish :shipit: 
deploy-bot: Merge scheduled — auto-merge in progress. Post-merge: kick canary ingestion check and alert on parsing errors for 30m :white_check_mark:
sam: thanks all! Will monitor canary and report back if anything odd shows up.
